Story #7 **landed**. PR [#8](https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-07-24-brownfield-longitudinal-mandrel-72244a0a/pull/8) merged to `main`, all close gates passed, code review returned 0 findings, and the ticket flipped to `agent::done`.

## Delivery summary

**Discovered & delivered** the plan the pipeline had already opened. This repo uses the Story-only v2 model (no Epic label exists), so the deliverable was **Story #7 — "Split client name into firstName and lastName"** (`agent::ready`, plan-run `048aba10`). Delivered inline via the single-story engine — `story-7` → PR #8 → squash-merge to `main`.

**Terminal envelope:** `status: landed`, phase `post-land`, PR state `MERGED`, checks `success`, gates `validation/baseSync/codeReview` all passed.

**What shipped** (9 declared files + 1 regression test):
- `src/lib/name.js` — the single split rule (before-last-space = firstName, last word = lastName; single word ⇒ lastName only) plus full-name derivation, shared by the backfill and the write path.
- Migration `006-client-names.sql` adds `first_name`/`last_name` (`TEXT NOT NULL`); `openDb()` backfills pre-existing rows in place, idempotently.
- Write path accepts `firstName`+`lastName` **or** a legacy `name` (split); explicit parts win over a co-submitted `name`; a non-empty effective `lastName` is required on create (422 `E_VALIDATION`).
- Responses carry `firstName`/`lastName` plus a derived full `name`; the receivables report joins the **live** client row so it shows the current name, not the order-time snapshot.
- Added `tests/client-names.test.js` covering the new behaviors.

**Verification:** full suite **142 pass / 0 fail**; lint + typecheck clean. A fresh maker-blind acceptance-critic scored **7/7 ACs met**; the acceptance-eval gate returned `proceed`. The critic flagged missing regression coverage for the new behavior, which I addressed by adding the dedicated test file before closing.

One cosmetic degradation: the post-land `main` fast-forward was skipped because the main checkout had pre-existing unrelated dirty files (`package.json`, `temp/standalone/plan-metrics.json` from before this session) — the merge itself stands.
